Messages.Author: jarkko...@hotmail.com
Messages.Body:
What happens when minion A plays Art's Traumatic Essence on
(untapped) minion B and minion B attempts to block it, when minion C
plays Siren's Lure and taps the ATE's target?

-Will ATE fail? (like playing a card you cannot pay for?)

Thanks!
-Jarkko

Art's Traumatic Essence [BL:R1, LoB:R]
Cardtype: Action
Discipline: Melpominee/Auspex
+1 stealth action.
[aus] (D) Tap any untapped minion.
[mel] (D) Tap any untapped minion, and that minion burns 1 blood or
life.
[MEL] (D) Put this card on any ready untapped minion and tap that
minion. The minion with this card burns 1 additional blood or life
each time he or she attempts to take an action or block. During his or
her master phase, the controller of the minion with this card may tap
this minion and burn a pool to burn this card. A minion may have only
one Art's Traumatic Essence.

Siren's Lure [BL:R1, LoB:R]
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Discipline: Melpominee/Celerity
[cel] This vampire burns 2 blood to get +1 stealth.
[mel] Only usable by an untapped ready vampire other than the acting
minion when a minion attempts to block. That minion cannot block this
action. Tap this vampire and that minion. Once the action resolves,
this vampire enters combat with that minion.
[MEL] As [mel] above, but do not tap this modifying vampire.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
jarkko...@hotmail.com wrote:
> What happens when minion A plays Art's Traumatic Essence on
> (untapped) minion B and minion B attempts to block it, when minion C
> plays Siren's Lure and taps the ATE's target?
>
> -Will ATE fail? (like playing a card you cannot pay for?)

The action fizzles, yes.
After "resolution" (fizzling), the Siren's Lure queued combat occurs.
